잠언-21-1.title: 잠언 21장 1절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-1.exegesis: 30. blueness-- literally, "joining," the process of uniting the edges of a wound throws off purulent matter. stripes ... belly-- So punishment provides healing of soul ( Pr 18:8 ), by deterring from evil courses.
잠언-21-1.theologicalNote: 30. blueness-- literally, "joining," the process of uniting the edges of a wound throws off purulent matter. stripes ... belly-- So punishment provides healing of soul ( Pr 18:8 ), by deterring from evil courses.

잠언-21-2.title: 잠언 21장 2절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-2.exegesis: CHAPTER 21 Pr 21:1-31 . 1. rivers-- irrigating channels ( Psa 1:3 ), whose course was easily turned (compare De 11:10 ). God disposes even kings as He pleases ( Pr 16:9 ; Psa 33:15 ).
잠언-21-2.theologicalNote: CHAPTER 21 Pr 21:1-31 . 1. rivers-- irrigating channels ( Psa 1:3 ), whose course was easily turned (compare De 11:10 ). God disposes even kings as He pleases ( Pr 16:9 ; Psa 33:15 ).

잠언-21-5.title: 잠언 21장 5절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-5.exegesis: 4. high look-- (Compare Margin; Psa 131:1 ). proud heart-- or, "heart of breadth," one that is swollen (compare Psa 101:5 ). ploughing-- better "lamp," a frequent figure for prosperity ( Pr 20:20 ); hence joy or delight.
잠언-21-5.theologicalNote: 4. high look-- (Compare Margin; Psa 131:1 ). proud heart-- or, "heart of breadth," one that is swollen (compare Psa 101:5 ). ploughing-- better "lamp," a frequent figure for prosperity ( Pr 20:20 ); hence joy or delight.

잠언-21-6.title: 잠언 21장 6절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-6.exegesis: 5. The contrast is between steady industry and rashness (compare Pr 19:2 ).
잠언-21-6.theologicalNote: 5. The contrast is between steady industry and rashness (compare Pr 19:2 ).

잠언-21-7.title: 잠언 21장 7절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-7.exegesis: 6. The getting-- or, "what is obtained" (compare Job 7:2 ; Jr 22:13 , Hebrew). vanity ... to and fro-- as fleeting as chaff or stubble in the wind (compare Pr 20:17-21 ; Psa 62:10 ). Such gettings are unsatisfactory. them ... death-- act as if they did ( Pr 8:36 ; 17:19 ).
잠언-21-7.theologicalNote: 6. The getting-- or, "what is obtained" (compare Job 7:2 ; Jr 22:13 , Hebrew). vanity ... to and fro-- as fleeting as chaff or stubble in the wind (compare Pr 20:17-21 ; Psa 62:10 ). Such gettings are unsatisfactory. them ... death-- act as if they did ( Pr 8:36 ; 17:19 ).

잠언-21-8.title: 잠언 21장 8절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-8.exegesis: 7. robbery-- or, "destruction," especially oppression, of which they are authors. shall destroy-- literally, "cut with a saw" ( 1Ki 7:9 ), that is, utterly ruin them. Their sins shall be visited on them in kind. to do judgment-- what is just and right.
잠언-21-8.theologicalNote: 7. robbery-- or, "destruction," especially oppression, of which they are authors. shall destroy-- literally, "cut with a saw" ( 1Ki 7:9 ), that is, utterly ruin them. Their sins shall be visited on them in kind. to do judgment-- what is just and right.

잠언-21-9.title: 잠언 21장 9절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-9.exegesis: 8. of man-- any one; his way is opposed to truth, and also estranged from it. The pure proves himself such by his right conduct.
잠언-21-9.theologicalNote: 8. of man-- any one; his way is opposed to truth, and also estranged from it. The pure proves himself such by his right conduct.

잠언-21-10.title: 잠언 21장 10절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-10.exegesis: 9. corner-- a turret or arbor on the roof. brawling-- or contentious. wide house-- literally, "house of fellowship," large enough for several families.
잠언-21-10.theologicalNote: 9. corner-- a turret or arbor on the roof. brawling-- or contentious. wide house-- literally, "house of fellowship," large enough for several families.

잠언-21-11.title: 잠언 21장 11절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-11.exegesis: 10. So strongly does he desire to do evil ( Psa 10:3 ; Ec 8:11 ), that he will not even spare his friend if in his way.
잠언-21-11.theologicalNote: 10. So strongly does he desire to do evil ( Psa 10:3 ; Ec 8:11 ), that he will not even spare his friend if in his way.

잠언-21-12.title: 잠언 21장 12절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-12.exegesis: 11. (Compare Pr 19:25 ). That which the simple learn by the terrors of punishment, the wise learn by teaching.
잠언-21-12.theologicalNote: 11. (Compare Pr 19:25 ). That which the simple learn by the terrors of punishment, the wise learn by teaching.

잠언-21-13.title: 잠언 21장 13절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-13.exegesis: 12. (Compare Psa 37:35-38; 73:17, 20). house-- family or interests. overthroweth-- either supply "God" (compare Pr 10:24 ), or the word is used impersonally.
잠언-21-13.theologicalNote: 12. (Compare Psa 37:35-38; 73:17, 20). house-- family or interests. overthroweth-- either supply "God" (compare Pr 10:24 ), or the word is used impersonally.

잠언-21-14.title: 잠언 21장 14절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-14.exegesis: 13. The principles of retribution, often taught (compare Psa 18:26 ; Mt 7:1-12 ).
잠언-21-14.theologicalNote: 13. The principles of retribution, often taught (compare Psa 18:26 ; Mt 7:1-12 ).

잠언-21-15.title: 잠언 21장 15절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-15.exegesis: 14. The effect of bribery ( Pr 17:23 ) is enhanced by secrecy, as the bribed person does not wish his motives made known.
잠언-21-15.theologicalNote: 14. The effect of bribery ( Pr 17:23 ) is enhanced by secrecy, as the bribed person does not wish his motives made known.

잠언-21-16.title: 잠언 21장 16절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-16.exegesis: 15. But the just love right and need no bribes. The wicked at last meet destruction, though for a time happy in concealing corruption.
잠언-21-16.theologicalNote: 15. But the just love right and need no bribes. The wicked at last meet destruction, though for a time happy in concealing corruption.

잠언-21-17.title: 잠언 21장 17절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-17.exegesis: 16. the way of understanding-- (Compare Pr 12:26 ; 14:22 ). remain-- that is, rest as at a journey's end; death will be his unchanging home.
잠언-21-17.theologicalNote: 16. the way of understanding-- (Compare Pr 12:26 ; 14:22 ). remain-- that is, rest as at a journey's end; death will be his unchanging home.

잠언-21-19.title: 잠언 21장 19절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-19.exegesis: 18. (Compare Pr 11:8 ). By suffering what they had devised for the righteous, or brought on them, the wicked became their ransom, in the usual sense of substitutes (compare Jos 7:26 ; Es 7:9 ).
잠언-21-19.theologicalNote: 18. (Compare Pr 11:8 ). By suffering what they had devised for the righteous, or brought on them, the wicked became their ransom, in the usual sense of substitutes (compare Jos 7:26 ; Es 7:9 ).

잠언-21-20.title: 잠언 21장 20절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-20.exegesis: 19. (Compare Pr 21:9 ). wilderness-- pasture, though uninhabitable ground ( Psa 65:12 ).
잠언-21-20.theologicalNote: 19. (Compare Pr 21:9 ). wilderness-- pasture, though uninhabitable ground ( Psa 65:12 ).

잠언-21-21.title: 잠언 21장 21절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-21.exegesis: 20. The wise, by diligence and care, lay up and increase wealth, while fools spend-- literally, "swallow it up," greedily.
잠언-21-21.theologicalNote: 20. The wise, by diligence and care, lay up and increase wealth, while fools spend-- literally, "swallow it up," greedily.

잠언-21-22.title: 잠언 21장 22절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-22.exegesis: 21. He who tries to act justly and kindly ( Psa 34:14 ) will prosper and obtain justice and honor.
잠언-21-22.theologicalNote: 21. He who tries to act justly and kindly ( Psa 34:14 ) will prosper and obtain justice and honor.

잠언-21-23.title: 잠언 21장 23절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-23.exegesis: 22. "Wisdom is better than strength" ( Ec 7:19 ; 9:15 ). strength ... thereof-- that in which they confide.
잠언-21-23.theologicalNote: 22. "Wisdom is better than strength" ( Ec 7:19 ; 9:15 ). strength ... thereof-- that in which they confide.

잠언-21-25.title: 잠언 21장 25절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-25.exegesis: 24. The reproachful name is deserved by those who treat others with anger and contempt.
잠언-21-25.theologicalNote: 24. The reproachful name is deserved by those who treat others with anger and contempt.

잠언-21-26.title: 잠언 21장 26절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-26.exegesis: 25. desire-- that is, of ease and idleness brings him to starvation.
잠언-21-26.theologicalNote: 25. desire-- that is, of ease and idleness brings him to starvation.

잠언-21-27.title: 잠언 21장 27절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-27.exegesis: 26. The sin of covetousness marks the sluggard, as the virtue of benevolence the righteous.
잠언-21-27.theologicalNote: 26. The sin of covetousness marks the sluggard, as the virtue of benevolence the righteous.

잠언-21-28.title: 잠언 21장 28절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-28.exegesis: 27. God regards the heart, and hypocrisy is more odious than open inconsistency. wicked mind-- or, "design" ( Pr 1:4 ).
잠언-21-28.theologicalNote: 27. God regards the heart, and hypocrisy is more odious than open inconsistency. wicked mind-- or, "design" ( Pr 1:4 ).

잠언-21-29.title: 잠언 21장 29절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-29.exegesis: 28. (Compare Pr 19:5 ). that heareth-- or heeds instruction, and so grows wise. speaketh constantly-- or sincerely (compare Ha 1:5 ), and hence is believed ( Pr 12:19 ; Jas 1:19 ).
잠언-21-29.theologicalNote: 28. (Compare Pr 19:5 ). that heareth-- or heeds instruction, and so grows wise. speaketh constantly-- or sincerely (compare Ha 1:5 ), and hence is believed ( Pr 12:19 ; Jas 1:19 ).

잠언-21-30.title: 잠언 21장 30절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-30.exegesis: 29. hardeneth his face-- is obstinate. directeth ... way-- considers it, and acts advisedly.
잠언-21-30.theologicalNote: 29. hardeneth his face-- is obstinate. directeth ... way-- considers it, and acts advisedly.

잠언-21-31.title: 잠언 21장 31절 역사문법적 주해
잠언-21-31.exegesis: 30-31. Men's best devices and reliances are vain compared with God's, or without His aid ( Pr 19:21 ; Psa 20:7 ; 33:17 ).
잠언-21-31.theologicalNote: 30-31. Men's best devices and reliances are vain compared with God's, or without His aid ( Pr 19:21 ; Psa 20:7 ; 33:17 ).
